correctness.rationale: With G=C_n^3 and facets V(G) minus independent triples, independent reconstruction enumerated all triples (13,28,50) and all nonempty faces (5434,13106,28803). Applying the actual packaged pivot permutations to all faces yields 2716,6552,14400 pairs, critical faces precisely {(1,0),(3492,5)}, {(2,0),(13492,6)}, {(2048,0),(14042,8),(21357,8)}. Every Hasse cover (31070,84910,205800) was independently oriented and all face vertices removed by topological sort, proving acyclicity. A single critical vertex and only positive-dimensional critical cells of one common dimension force integral wedges S5, S6 and S8 vee S8 by discrete Morse theory, not merely mod-two ranks.
